verdict.rationale: Secureframe supports background automations like continuous compliance monitoring, automated evidence collection, and recurring access reviews with alerts (docs-12, docs-13, docs-27, docs-31), and its MCP server explicitly supports headless setups like CI jobs and scripts (docs-37, docs-38), enabling programmatic/autonomous use. However, there is no evidence of a general-purpose automation/workflow builder for AI-native users to configure arbitrary autonomous agent behaviors beyond compliance-specific monitoring tasks. Missing for 10: evidence of user-configurable autonomous agent workflows beyond built-in compliance monitoring, and independent confirmation the MCP server runs unattended in production.
